'''Solaflora''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sunfleur]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Heliabloom]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "As a plant, living in the ocean was never an option. But with those leaves transformed into a surfboard, Solaflora can make waves anywhere."

Solaflora is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A bipedal sunflower creature riding a leaf like a surfboard. Its head is creamy-white with yellow petals, and it has a happy facial expression. Its two arms/cannons are also yellow flowers, but are loaded with red, cylindrical seeds that function as ammo and have smiley faces on them.

Solaflora's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its yellow petals with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Solaflora's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Heliabloom]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Purchase any 20 buildings. Bring your [[Camp]] to life!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Solaflora is dual wielding flowery jet cannons. Please evolve again to fully unlock these weapons."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Riding the leaves like a surfboard, Solaflora is a ball of sunshine that spreads warmth and laughter, delighting fellow Tatari with petals."
